title: Geneva Bible (1560) - Part 1, Pages 1-600
author: Unknown
description: The first portion (pages 1-600) of a facsimile-derived text of the 1560 Geneva Bible, the landmark English Protestant translation produced by Marian exiles in Geneva. This part covers the opening of the volume, including the title and preliminary matter and the books of the Old Testament from Genesis onward, as far as page 600 of the original, with the translators' marginal notes, chapter arguments and cross-references in sixteenth-century spelling. The Geneva Bible was the first English Bible with verse numbers, the most popular English Bible of the Elizabethan age and the Bible of Shakespeare and the Puritans. It is a companion to the library's other Geneva Bible files, which hold the full text, the tables and the Apocryphal Wisdom of Solomon.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: Scan of the 1560 Geneva Bible text; the underlying work is public domain. The rights status of this particular scan/OCR has not been confirmed.
